CREATE UNIQUE INDEX exit_one_open ON exit_process(person_id, core_id)
WHERE stage != 'COMPLETED'

            BEFORE delete ON local_credential_audit
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'credential audit is append-only'); END
